$comment: The fourteen PRD section 45.3 'Target local commands', transcribed verbatim from docs/PRD.md.
Single source of truth for the entry-command sweep (tools/check-workspace.mjs) and for the README test.
`command` is always the verbatim section 45.3 string. `run` is what the sweep executes; it defaults
to `command` and may differ ONLY where a `deviation` states the reason and the ticket section that
made it spec (FND-01 v1.1, sub-PRD decision D18).
A failure waiver is forbidden: no entry may carry `known_failing`, `expected_failure`, `allow_failure`
or any equivalent. Every entry must exit 0 (FND-01 acceptance item 2, unconditional); a command that
cannot is a red acceptance item and an escalation, never a fixture annotation. Asserted by
tools/tests/entry-commands.test.mjs.
Two axes, and only two, may separate what is executed from the normative string (FND-22, PRD-02
requirement DEV-006). First: `command` is always the verbatim section 45.3 string, and `run` is
always exactly `command + ' ' + deviation.argument` — the default invocation, which is the one used
on Windows. Second: an optional `platforms` object, keyed by `process.platform` values, may
substitute ONLY the leading interpreter token of `command` for the named platform, and each record
must carry `interpreter`, `run`, `reason`, `authorisedBy` and `durableFix`. A platform record may
not change the script path, add an argument, or drop one. A substitution is exceptional and
declared, exactly as a deviation is — it is never a table every entry carries.
The waiver ban above holds on every platform: no entry and no platform record may say that a
command is unsupported, failing, skipped or waived anywhere. A command that cannot exit 0 on a
supported platform is a red acceptance item and an escalation (phase-2 Q-CI-D), never an
annotation. Both consumers select the invocation through the single resolveInvocation() exported
by tools/check-workspace.mjs.

commands.description: Install the pnpm workspace from the committed lockfile without rewriting it.

deviation.reason: The frozen script defaults -Path to (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)/PRD.md, i.e. repo-root PRD.md, while this repository's PRD lives at docs/PRD.md. Without the argument it throws 'PRD not found' and exits 1; with it, it exits 0 (Result: PASS).
deviation.authorisedBy: FND-01 v1.1 — Background 'Accepted caveats', deliverables 8 and 10, acceptance item 2; sub-PRD 00-foundation decision D18
deviation.durableFix: Escalated (non-blocking) to the Architect/founder: either unfreeze tools/validate-prd.ps1 in breakdown plan section 4 for a one-line default-path change, or amend the PRD section 45.3 text. Both are outside FND-01's file-scope.

linux.reason: The verbatim PRD 45.3 leading token `powershell` is the Windows PowerShell 5.1 executable and does not exist on a Linux runner: `/bin/sh: 1: powershell: not found`, exit 127 (PRD-02 section 1, failure class 1). PowerShell 7 is preinstalled on ubuntu-latest as `pwsh`, and tools/validate-prd.ps1 runs unmodified under it.
linux.authorisedBy: FND-22 — deliverable 1; PRD-02 section 2 requirement DEV-006
linux.durableFix: Escalated (non-blocking) to the Architect/founder as phase-2 Q-CI-D: either amend the PRD section 45.3 command text, or unfreeze tools/validate-prd.ps1 — the same two fixes D18 named. Both are outside a Builder's file-scope.
